arguments.message: Sure! To change who receives your invoice emails, open **Settings → Billing → Recipients** in your workspace. From there you can add a new billing contact email or replace the existing one – you can even add multiple addresses (e.g., a shared finance inbox) alongside an individual’s address. The change takes effect on the next invoice generated; past invoices won’t be resent to the new address.
